meta.case: a dataMessage whose group context reports an UPDATE (title/avatar/membership changed at a revision)

semantics.actor: envelope.source — the member whose client relayed the update; Signal does not say who changed the group
semantics.notes: The wire carries only the new group name and revision — never WHICH member/title/avatar fact changed. Detail requires a getGroup RPC read at that revision; a snapshot must not fabricate a change history.
semantics.today: parse_event returns None — no message text, and groupInfo.type is unread
